    - heading "Everything an analyst needs, in one agent" [level=2]
    - paragraph: From data scraping to executive decks, Manus handles the tools so you can focus on insight. One prompt sets the entire workflow in motion.
    - heading "Slides" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Generate polished executive decks and strategy presentations from a brief. Manus handles layout, copy, and data charts so your story lands every time.
    - heading "Design" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Create branded reports, one-pagers, and infographics without a designer. Describe what you need and get stakeholder-ready assets in minutes.
    - heading "Video" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Produce data walkthroughs, explainer clips, and recorded briefings from your scripts and charts. Complete with voiceover, music, and captions.
    - heading "Web" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Build interactive dashboards, data portals, and internal tools that are live and shareable. No code, no staging environment, no developer tickets.
    - heading "Browser Operator" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Let Manus navigate the web on your behalf to scrape datasets, pull financial filings, or monitor industry sources. Hands-free research at scale.
    - heading "Connectors" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Plug into Slack, Google Drive, Notion, Airtable, and more. Manus reads your existing data and writes results back where your team already works.
    - heading "Data visualization" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Turn raw metrics into clear, presentation-ready charts and dashboards. Spot trends, compare segments, and share insights with stakeholders at a glance.
    - heading "Spreadsheet" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Clean, enrich, and analyze data across CSVs and Excel files. Manus builds formulas, pivot tables, and scoring models so you never start from scratch.
    - heading "Wide Research" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Research hundreds of companies, markets, or data points in a single prompt. Manus works in parallel across sources and delivers structured findings ready for analysis.
    - heading "Skills" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Extend Manus with reusable workflows for data pipelines, report templates, competitive trackers, and more. Build once, run on every project that follows.
    - heading "Connectors for Analysts" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Pull data from your sources and push results back where your team works — no manual exports, no copy-pasting, no context switching.

    - heading "Frequently Asked Questions" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Find answers to common questions about our AI business analysis tools.
    - heading "Can I customize the generated financial models?" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Yes, all generated spreadsheets and models are fully customizable. Manus can use AI to a build financial model from data to give you a strong starting point. You can then easily edit formulas, change assumptions, and adjust the formatting to fit your specific needs.
    - heading "What data sources can Manus connect to?" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Manus connects seamlessly to various data sources including Google Drive, Notion, and Airtable. Furthermore, it can automate data scraping and analysis to extract valuable information from unstructured websites. This ensures you always have the right data for your research.
    - heading "How can I analyze competitor data with AI?" [level=3]
    - paragraph: You can easily analyze competitor data using our advanced benchmarking tools. The system automatically scans competitor pages and financial filings to extract valuable insights. This allows you to track social performance, ad spend, and product launches to stay ahead of the market.
    - heading "Is it possible to automate recurring market reports?" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Yes, you can schedule autonomous agents to monitor market trends and deliver recurring intelligence reports on autopilot. This ensures your team always has the latest market sizing and validation data without having to manually repeat the same research workflows every week.
    - heading "Can Manus create interactive dashboards from CSV files?" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Yes, Manus lets you create dashboard from spreadsheet data in just a few minutes. Simply upload your CSV files, and it will transform those raw numbers into live, filterable dashboards. This makes it incredibly easy to visualize trends and share insights.
    - heading "How do I process unstructured data like PDFs?" [level=3]
    - paragraph: To process unstructured data, just upload your PDFs or images. Manus will extract the information, clean it, and organize it into a structured dataset in Excel or your preferred database. This eliminates hours of tedious manual data entry and reconciliation work.
    - heading "Can I use Manus to research hundreds of companies at once?" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Yes, Manus makes it easy to batch research companies by deploying AI agents in parallel. You can go from a simple target list to a rich, comprehensive dataset in minutes. This dramatically accelerates your top-of-funnel deal sourcing and market research efforts.
    - heading "Is it secure to let Manus browse the web on my behalf?" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Yes. The Browser Operator functions as a secure extension that transforms your local web browser into an autonomous agent. It securely utilizes your existing logins and active tabs to complete tasks on authenticated sites (like CRMs or premium research tools) without triggering CAPTCHAs. You maintain full control, must authorize every session, and can stop the agent at any time by closing the browser tab. All actions are logged for complete transparency.

Network content is retained only when selected; Playwright response-body bytes are API results and are not guaranteed to match wire bytes.
Request bytes are limited to what Playwright exposes; not_exposed does not establish body absence or multipart file coverage.
Network content reads settle within 5 seconds each and the observer does not request bodies from unfinished responses.
Playwright scenario events do not expose request initiator stacks; receipt order does not prove causality.
Storage values are hashed only after declared-secret redaction.
